final: SELECT ma.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, 1.0 * SUM(i.amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total_income FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major AS ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.college
